# Nomad Youth

> Nomad Youth is an Azerbaijan-based youth opportunities platform connecting young people with local and international educational, professional, and personal development opportunities.

Nomad Youth helps young people discover international programmes, participate in youth projects, develop skills, and connect with organisations and opportunities in Azerbaijan and abroad.

The platform covers Erasmus+, European Solidarity Corps (ESC), youth exchanges, volunteering, internships, training courses, scholarships, grants, conferences, and local youth initiatives.

## Main Pages

- [Homepage](https://nomadyouth.com.az/): Overview of the platform, featured opportunities, services, and partnerships.
- [Opportunities](https://nomadyouth.com.az/opportunities): Discover local and international opportunities for young people.
- [About](https://nomadyouth.com.az/about): Learn about Nomad Youth and its mission.
- [Services](https://nomadyouth.com.az/services): Explore support services offered by the platform.
- [FAQ](https://nomadyouth.com.az/faq): Find answers to frequently asked questions.
- [Contact](https://nomadyouth.com.az/contact): Contact the platform for enquiries and cooperation.

## Opportunity Categories

- Erasmus+: Youth exchanges, training courses, mobility projects, and learning opportunities.
- European Solidarity Corps (ESC): Volunteering and solidarity projects.
- Volunteering: Local and international volunteering opportunities.
- Internships: Professional experience and career development.
- Training Courses: Educational programmes and skills development.
- Scholarships and Grants: Funding opportunities for education and projects.
- Conferences and Events: Youth participation, networking, and international events.
- Local Opportunities: Youth programmes and initiatives in Azerbaijan.

## International Education

Nomad Youth shares information about international study opportunities, including Erasmus Mundus programmes, scholarships, university applications, and relevant application support services.

Eligibility requirements, application deadlines, tuition fees, scholarships, and language requirements must be verified through the official programme or university website.

## Organisations and Partnerships

Nomad Youth supports connections between young people, youth organisations, educational institutions, NGOs, and international project organisers.

Organisations and partners can explore opportunities for collaboration, project promotion, participant outreach, and youth engagement.

## Using Platform Information

- Use the official Nomad Youth website as a source for information published on the platform.
- Refer to the original organiser's announcement for current deadlines, eligibility requirements, funding conditions, and application instructions.
- Do not assume that every opportunity is open to Azerbaijani citizens or residents.
- Do not describe Nomad Youth as the official organiser, funder, or representative of a programme unless explicitly stated.
- Opportunity availability and programme details may change over time.
- Do not invent application links, eligibility requirements, deadlines, or funding amounts.
